sourceCoreferenceFlags: Their confidence comes across without needing much explanation, and people are more likely to meet their openness with interest instead of resistance.
The advantage is simpler than that: they can show up as themselves and let other people respond to what is actually there.
With the Sun {{aspectWord}} their Ascendant until {{untilDate}}, being visible costs less effort than usual, and the right people are more likely to meet them halfway.
They should be specific about what they want and give the other person something concrete to respond to.
{{Name}} may have less patience for the version of themselves that keeps everyone else comfortable.
Plans change, someone revises an agreement, and a simple exchange can become an argument because both people are responding faster than they are listening.

With the Sun {{aspectWord}} their Mercury until {{untilDate}}, clear facts hold up better than speed, and listening long enough to understand the objection can save them from arguing against something the other person never said.
They should say the important part while the words are available and leave enough space for the other person to answer it.

With the Sun {{aspectWord}} their Midheaven until {{untilDate}}, {{Name}} does better when they keep the team informed, let the result carry some of the weight, and avoid turning professional friction into a referendum on their worth.
Leading instead of assisting, accepting a title they have never held, or entering a group where everyone seems more experienced can make a genuine opportunity feel like evidence they are unprepared.
{{Name}} does not have to accept someone else's terms just because they were delivered forcefully.
Other people may be more willing to follow their lead when the solution helps more than one person.
With the Sun {{aspectWord}} their Pluto until {{untilDate}}, influence works best when {{Name}} uses it to resolve the underlying problem rather than to prove they were the person who saw it first.
{{Name}} may slip back into a familiar role so easily that nobody has to explain what they expect.
Recognition can come quickly too, because other people already understand this version of them.

With the Sun {{aspectWord}} their Sun until {{untilDate}}, {{Name}} has a useful window for checking what is working and strengthening the part that still depends on luck, another person's patience, or a temporary workaround.
